dialect.detail: IBM-PC targeted COBOL, likely Micro Focus Personal COBOL or similar PC COBOL compiler; SOURCE-COMPUTER/OBJECT-COMPUTER set to IBM-PC, LINE SEQUENTIAL files, PRINTER keyword in SELECT

purpose.domain_detail: Employee payroll processing: reads payroll data file, calculates gross pay, tax (25%), super (6%), union and mortgage deductions, prints per-employee lines and summary totals
purpose.summary: Reads employee payroll records from a disc file (PAY4DATA), calculates gross pay by multiplying hours by rate, deducts tax (25%), superannuation (6%), union fees, and mortgage payments to arrive at net pay. Prints a formatted payroll listing with headings and end-of-run totals including exceptions for employees where deductions exceeded net pay.

notable_features: SECTION-based PROCEDURE DIVISION with explicit EXIT paragraphs
REDEFINES used for OR-UNION-X and OR-MORTGAGE-X to allow asterisk override
88-level condition names for EOF and deduction exception indicators
BLANK WHEN ZERO on output fields
WRITE ... AFTER NEW-PAGE using SPECIAL-NAMES mnemonic C01
COMP binary fields for counters and totals (no COMP-3)
Reference to WF-SUPER in PROCEDURE DIVISION but no corresponding WS definition visible (possible bug/truncation)
PERFORM 4D-ACCUM-TOTALS calls paragraph named 4D but accumulation section is 4C (likely bug)
Trailing 'Page 6' text at end of file suggesting copy-paste from a word-processed document
verdict.notes: The file is named PAY9.CBL but PROGRAM-ID is PAY4, suggesting it is one of several versions of a student payroll exercise. There is a reference to WF-SUPER in 4A-CALC-VALUES but no PIC clause for it in WORKING-STORAGE (probable bug or truncated listing). The accumulation section is named 4C but is called as 4D-ACCUM-TOTALS in 3A, and 4D is used for print-totals — likely a student error. The trailing 'Page 6' line at the end appears to be a word-processor page marker included accidentally. Overall this is a student payroll exercise, likely from a PC COBOL course.
